event_title: BİLTEK 16th International Congress on Scientific Research and Current Developments
paper_title: What can students do when AI support is removed? A comparison of three experiments in mathematics and science education
source_basis: Owner-supplied acceptance/invitation letter, reviewed 25 November 2026. The letter confirms acceptance of the abstract for oral presentation; the original signed document is not a public site asset.

summary.en: Hüseyin Ateş's abstract on what students can do when AI support is removed has been accepted for oral presentation at BİLTEK 16, taking place on 23–28 January 2027 in Sharm El-Sheikh, Egypt.
summary.tr: Hüseyin Ateş'in yapay zekâ desteği kaldırıldığında öğrencilerin neler yapabildiğini ele alan bildiri özeti, 23–28 Ocak 2027 tarihlerinde Şarm El-Şeyh, Mısır'da düzenlenecek BİLTEK 16'da sözlü sunum için kabul edildi.
summary.de: Hüseyin Ateşs Abstract zu der Frage, was Lernende nach dem Wegfall von KI-Unterstützung leisten können, wurde für einen mündlichen Vortrag beim BİLTEK 16 angenommen. Der Kongress findet vom 23. bis 28. Januar 2027 in Scharm El-Scheich, Ägypten, statt.

en.scope: The contribution compares three experiments in mathematics and science education to examine what students can do after AI support is removed.

tr.scope: Bildiri, yapay zekâ desteği kaldırıldıktan sonra öğrencilerin neler yapabildiğini matematik ve fen eğitimindeki üç deney üzerinden karşılaştırmalı olarak ele alıyor.

de.scope: Der Beitrag vergleicht drei Experimente in der Mathematik- und Naturwissenschaftsdidaktik zur Frage, was Lernende nach dem Wegfall von KI-Unterstützung leisten können.
